title: IM60049: Technology Forecasting And Assessment
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Need for Technological Forecasting and its scope, Technological Forecasting
methods: Brain Storming, Expert Opinion, Nominal Group technique, Delphi and
its Variants; Analogy, Trend Extrapolation, Structural Modelling Methods- ISM
and KSIM, Gross Impact Analysis, System Dynamics Introduction to technology
Assessment History, Definition, need and scope, present status in India,
Institutionalization of TA, TA methodology- steps to conduct TA-applications.
Text

•Management of Technology (Hardcover) by Tarek Khalil, Maximilian von Zedtwitz,
Georges Haour, Louis A. Lefebvre, Pergamon.
•Management of Technology: Key Success Factors for Innovation and Sustainable
Development by Laure Morel- Guimaraes, Tarek Khalil, Yasser A Hosni , Elsevier
Science.

Samson , McGraw-Hill/Irwin; 1 edition, 2001, ISBN: 0072383550
